subject.title: feat(models): make per-agent model allowlist explicit; aliases/defaults no longer restrict

question: Should OpenClaw standardize `agents.defaults.modelPolicy.allow` and `agents.list[].modelPolicy.allow` as the durable public authorization contract, with legacy default model maps retained only through migration?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive public config and plugin-SDK expansion, not merely an internal bug fix; only maintainers can decide whether this is the intended permanent configuration direction.

options.title: Approve explicit policy contract
options.body: Accept `modelPolicy.allow` as the canonical override restriction after reviewing upgrade proof and the plugin-SDK compatibility surface.

options.title: Keep the current contract
options.body: Retain the existing model-map authorization semantics and pursue a narrower fix that avoids adding a new public policy shape.

options.title: Narrow before acceptance
options.body: Keep the separation goal but reduce or defer the per-agent/plugin-facing surface until a smaller owner-approved contract is defined.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit policy contract
recommendation.body: Accept `modelPolicy.allow` as the canonical override restriction after reviewing upgrade proof and the plugin-SDK compatibility surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch history ties this person to the proposed configuration boundary, though current-main ownership remains unverified.
